## LmdbEnv class

The root handle for one LMDB environment and its registered subs.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class LmdbEnv 
```

## Remarks

One env per process is the common pattern (LMDB is designed for single-writer / multi-reader). The env lazily opens sub-databases on first access and caches them inside lmdb-js's native store layer.

Each instance owns a \*\*private per-instance\*\* lmdb root store (built via `openAsClass` in the constructor) so that sub-database (`openDB`<!-- -->) handle caches are naturally isolated across envs — lmdb-js caches handles on the store instance, and a single shared base class would leak handles across envs in the same process. Native store methods (`transaction`<!-- -->, `openDB`<!-- -->, `close`<!-- -->, `backup`<!-- -->, etc.) are forwarded explicitly.

Collection operations are NOT on this class — register a schema class to get a typed [LmdbEnvSub](./lmdb.lmdbenvsub.md) handle, or use [LmdbEnv.sub()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.sub.md) to fetch an already-registered one.
